# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Stacy is a bright, young woman with fair, curly hair and fascinating eyes. She dresses stylishly and wears fashionably large sleeve puffs.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

Miss Stacy is a sympathetic, bright, and ladylike teacher with a sweet voice. She possesses a happy gift for winning the affection of her students, bringing out their best qualities, and encouraging them to explore and discover things for themselves. She is open to constructive methods, such as letting pupils ask questions during lessons, and she maintains an enthusiastic, helpful attitude toward her class.

_Sources: [v1 c21 P7](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0007), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)_

## Traits

- Bright and sympathetic  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- Encouraging and tactful  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)</sub>
- Broadminded and helpful  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching and guiding students  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)</sub>
- Organizing educational field days and school concerts  <sub>[v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010)</sub>
- Instructing physical culture and recitations  <sub>[v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)</sub>

## Goals

- To bring out the best in her pupils mentally and morally  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- To prepare her advanced students to pass the entrance examination for Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy is hired as the new teacher for Avonlea School, succeeding Mr. Phillips as the first female teacher in the village's history. She quickly wins the hearts of her pupils by introducing interactive teaching methods, physical culture exercises, nature field days, and Friday recitation afternoons. In November of her first year, she organizes a successful student concert to raise funds for a schoolhouse flag. Later, she forms an advanced class for students preparing for the Queen's Academy entrance examinations. Although offered a position in her home district's grade school, she decides to remain in Avonlea to see her entrance class through to their exams. Under her guidance and drilling, all of her candidates successfully pass their Queen's entrance examinations at the end of the term.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c31 P10](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0010), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042)_

## Background by volume

- She was hired as the first female teacher in Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- Was offered a position in the grade school of her home district, but chose to stay in Avonlea out of devotion to her pupils  <sub>[v1 c30 P30](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0030), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

## Quotes

> I thought of taking another school, but I have decided to come back to Avonlea. To tell the truth, I’ve grown so interested in my pupils here that I found I couldn’t leave them. So I’ll stay and see you through.  <sub>[v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

> But you’ve done good work this past year, and you deserve a good, jolly vacation. Have the best time you can in the out-of-door world and lay in a good stock of health and vitality and ambition to carry you through next year.  <sub>[v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029)</sub>
